}}'''Eldase Takashi''' is part of the [[Knitting Circle]] in the [[Kin]] based in [[Ebou Dar]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Eldase Takashi}}

== Appearance ==
She has fierce eyes and looked fierce. She had two streaks of white in her hair.

== Activities ==
Born in {{ne|665}}, she went to the White Tower in {{ne|683}}. She spent 13 years a novice and 7 as Accepted before being put out of the White Tower.

Her Saidar strength is {{opsl|47}}, strong enough to test for Aes Sedai. However, she was put out of the White Tower as an Accepted because of her intractable temper, which made her a severe discipline problem.

In Ebou Dar, she sold lacquerware to merchants for export.

She [[Traveling|Travels]] with the the rest of the group led by [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] and [[Elayne Trakand]] from Ebou Dar to the Kin's [[farm]] with the [[Bowl of the Winds]].
